long_biography.plain_text:
Primal Marine acts as a commercial link among cargo interests, shipowners and traders, arranging dry-cargo charters and commercial representation. Its particular specialism is fertilizer freight, supported by work involving grain, cement, steel and mineral cargoes. The business also maintains relationships with operators and a network of bulk-carrier tonnage across different vessel sizes.

Efthymios Pournaras leads this operation as the company's general manager. The role is grounded in brokerage: supplying market knowledge, interpreting both cargo and vessel requirements, and matching transport demand with suitable commercial tonnage. That work places him at the practical centre of a specialist shipping service whose reputation rests on repeated fixtures and long-standing client relationships.
